bounded_pilot_design.step_1: one instrument scale measurement + one camera exposure/timestamp characterization + one B-off/blank capture + one known-D standard capture
bounded_pilot_design.step_2: only after ALL step-1 inputs: at most 2 physics-condition pilots with held-out experimental time windows, amplitude/phase/background/model and measurement uncertainty budgets, and a P0-convergence assessment
bounded_pilot_design.route_note: route A (independent trajectory) preferred when available; route B needs B(t)/gradient/sync + mechanics; 200Hz drive does not imply 400Hz translation; unknown z/orientation keep bounded-uncertainty placeholders, never 0
